narrative.details:
The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order.

Work Order AL-1420:

15 Greater Arcane Protection Potions.

All filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Contract is null and void if tampered with or damaged.

-Dispatch Commander Metz, The Argent Dawn
narrative.objectives: Deliver 15 Greater Arcane Protection Potions and the Craftsman's Writ - Greater Arcane Protection Potion - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
narrative.offerRewardText:
<Packmaster Stonebruiser pops open one of the greater arcane protection potions and take a swig.>

WOOT! These pack a kick, baby! A kick I say!
